score_meaning: Average of the gradient boosting and ridge models' predicted percentile of forward price growth within the NYC metro, 0-100. Not an absolute forecast.
historical_growth_vs_metro_pct_meaning: What NYC ZIPs at this predicted percentile realized over the horizon, relative to the metro, in past origins. A historical analogue, not a forecast.
price_vs_metro_median_pct_meaning: ZHVI relative to the NYC-metro median ZIP.
